query: Consider the Confidentiality Agreement between Tazza and CAFFE; Does the document permit the Receiving Party to retain some Confidential Information even after its return or destruction?
gold: Any copies of the materials that may have been made must be destroyed (subject to applicable laws and in consideration of requirements for internal auditing, in which case the provisions of the present Agreement will continue to be applied to the confidential information which remains to be processed) in compliance with the procedure determined by the Franchisor concerning the destruction of similar confidential material.
rag_answer: Yes. Under the Confidentiality Agreement, the Receiving Party (the “potential Franchisee”) must return all materials containing Confidential Information and destroy any copies upon the Franchisor’s request or at the Franchisor’s discretion. However, the agreement permits retention where required by applicable laws or internal auditing requirements. In that case, the Confidential Information may remain retained, but the confidentiality obligations under the agreement continue to apply to it.

judge.gold_summary: 协议要求销毁任何副本，但在适用法律和内部审计要求下可保留仍需处理的机密信息，且本协议保密条款继续适用于该信息。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出接收方原则上应返还并销毁机密信息，但允许在适用法律或内部审计要求下保留，且保密义务继续适用。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键要点：允许因法律或内部审计需要保留部分机密信息，并明确保留信息仍受保密协议约束。
